data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 17.8m (2015: favourable development of GBP 16.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business and GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross favourable prior year development of GBP 8.941 million, representing a 1.97% release of opening gross reserves. This was primarily driven by releases across a number of Casualty classes, including Third Party Liability, Aviation, and Reinsurance business, as indicated by the net movement narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes
releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business
releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 9 explicitly states a net favourable development of GBP 17.8m. However, the gross prior year development of -GBP 8.941m was calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 18, as per instructions to prioritize gross figures from triangles over net narrative figures. The LOB breakdown for prior year movements provided in the narrative is for the net figure and cannot be directly applied to the gross figure.
